summative_rubric.title: G1 Classroom Market — Summative Rubric
summative_rubric.purpose: Used during and after Lesson 5 to score against F1.1.

rows.expectation_text: identify the various Canadian coins up to 50¢ and coins and bills up to $50, and compare their values

levels.descriptor: Cannot name most coins or bills.
Names some coins/bills with prompts and frequent errors.
Independently names 6 coins and 4 bills and compares their values.
Combines coins/bills and explains equivalence and value relationships.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Score during Lesson 5 capstone. Level 3 = grade-level.

summative_task_script.title: Big Market Capstone — Summative Administration Guide
summative_task_script.purpose: Ties Lesson 5 capstone, the 4 stations, and the rubric together.
administration_steps: Before: photocopy templates, print rubric, ready Junior Shopper certificates.
Stations 1-4 (5 min each): COINS, BILLS, COMPARE, BUY.
Station 1 COINS: name 4 coins. Evidence F1.1.
Station 2 BILLS: name 4 bills. Evidence F1.1.
Station 4 BUY: pay for 2 items. Evidence F1.1.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Use the Capstone Template as primary evidence. Level 3 = grade-level.
